metadata.name: Directory Bla Counter
metadata.description: Reads every .md file in a directory, counts occurrences of the word 'bla' across all of them, and produces a short summary. Demonstrates input(directory) -> code(whole_list, read_file_inputs) -> text_output.
metadata.author: AI-Graph

nodes.label: Count Bla
nodes.description: Counts total 'bla' occurrences across all file contents and produces a summary

config.code_prompt: Given a list of text file contents, produce a short summary of the combined text and count the total number of times the word 'bla' appears across all files. Return {'summary': str, 'bla_count': int}.
config.code:
def run(inputs):
    files = inputs['files']
    
    # Combine all file contents
    combined_text = ' '.join(files)
    
    # Create a summary (first 100 characters plus "...")
    summary = combined_text[:100] + ("..." if len(combined_text) > 100 else "")
    
    # Count occurrences of 'bla' (case insensitive)
    bla_count = combined_text.lower().count('bla')
    
    outputs = {
        'summary': summary,
        'bla_count': bla_count
    }
    
    return outputs

nodes.label: Result
nodes.description: Displays the summary and bla count
